sub_agendas_items.title: Chair of the Board of Health Verbal Report
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
As part of her verbal report, Chair Kitts, congratulated Board Member, Dr. Danielle Brown-Shreves, for two recent awards – the Family Physician of the Year Award from the Ontario College of Family Physicians, and the Top 100 Award from the Women’s Executive Network. She talked about the impacts of stressful events and pointed to some OPH resources to help people cope. She provided an update on hers, Vice-Chair DeGiovanni’s and Member Bauer’s recent participation in the Association of Local Public Health Agencies’ (alPHa) Fall Symposium. The Chair then highlighted AIDS Awareness Day and some holiday messaging, including tips for protecting ourselves against the respiratory illnesses circulating in our community. 
Discussions on this item lasted approximately 10 minutes. The Board then voted to RECEIVE the Chair's Verbal Report.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive this verbal report for information.

sub_agendas_items.title: Medical Officer of Health Verbal Report
sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Dr. Etches began her verbal report by recognizing the many employees who have been with Ottawa Public Health through the pandemic, as the health unit reaches the final phase of demobilizing its dedicated COVID-19 response. She noted that the work related to COVID-19 and respiratory viruses is not ended and she talked about the many aspects that will continue, as part of core operations. She talked about National Day of Remembrance and Action on Violence Against Women and provided a look ahead to 2024 and the ways in which OPH’s work will be guided by its multi-year strategic objectives. 
Following her verbal report, Dr. Etches responded to questions from Board Members. 
Discussions on this item lasted approximately 25 minutes. The Board then voted to RECEIVE the Medical Officer of Health's Verbal Report.

motions.motion_text: That the Board of Health for the City of Ottawa Health Unit receive this verbal report for information.
